title: cbr verdict-artifact
description: Verdict written by a fresh reviewer/tester agent for an SDLC checkpoint (REVIEW/SECURITY/UNIT/INTEGRATION). Documents the shape hooks/verdict-gate.py enforces by hand (validate_shape()) — this file is not loaded by the validator; keep the two in sync manually.

gate.description: Which SDLC checkpoint this verdict is for. (Pre-0.11.0 G4/G5a/G6/G7 filenames are no longer read — the read-compat shim was removed in 0.14.0.)

decision.description: Overall verdict. PASS means the gate criteria are objectively met.

findings.description: Open findings. Any Critical finding blocks the gate regardless of decision; for SECURITY, an unresolved Major also blocks (the schema has no separate 'High' value).

severity.description: Critical = system crash, data loss, security breach, or auth bypass (blocks the gate). Major = a feature broken with no workaround. Minor = degraded with a workaround. Info = cosmetic or a suggestion.

verification.description: Commands run as evidence (SECURITY/UNIT/INTEGRATION require >=1 with result 'pass').

secretsScanned.description: Producer's claim it scanned for secrets; the validator scans independently.

producedBy.description: Agent/skill that produced this verdict, e.g. cbr-reviewer.
